description: Architecture atlas top-level document — one of the four atlas index files (file-index, connectivity-matrix, systems-index, cross-system-map). Produced by /architecture-survey full bootstrap passes. Carries a single survey clock (last_mapped) keyed on the full re-bootstrap run date; does NOT carry last_attested (the targeted-audit two-clock split applies only to per-system docs, not top-level atlas files). Spec backlink: coordinator/docs/wiki/canonical-artifact-shapes.md § Atlas documents.

last_mapped.description: Date of the last full atlas re-bootstrap that wrote this file (YYYY-MM-DD). Survey clock — updated only by full /architecture-survey passes, never by targeted audits.

mode.description: Description of the run mode that produced this atlas file (e.g. 'full re-bootstrap (run 2026-06-18-22h16)'). Free-form; for observability only.
